verdict.rationale: The docs show tables pulled into pandas DataFrames with source-page provenance (docs-15), schema-driven JSON extraction (docs-13, docs-14, docs-42), and table row extraction for repeating entities (docs-34), which together cover typed, load-ready rows. One early hands-on user found table numbers did not come out in tabular form (comm-6), but that is an interface-confusion report rather than a concrete refutation of the documented DataFrame and schema outputs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that the typed table output needs no manual cleanup, and documented paths for loading into or mapping to database schemas and types.
